text:
incident-bot: SEV2 · multiple nodes NotReady in cluster infer-usw affecting inference-pool-usw (3/12 nodes). error rate up, tail latency spiking. paging on-call
anya: oncall here, seeing alerts. checking node state and kubelet logs
mike: i'm hopping on. have console and ssh access to the affected AZ
jon: tagging network and infra in case it's not just kubelet. any customer-facing hit yet?
sara: alert from status page: some customers seeing 500s on /v1/generate in us-west. listing a few tenants reporting degraded latency.
anya: quick triage: kubectl get nodes -o wide on inference pool shows these nodes NotReady: infer-usw-3, infer-usw-7, infer-usw-9
anya: running: kubectl describe node infer-usw-7 | grep -i kubelet
-----snip-----
Kubelet has no cgroup driver for runtime
NodeStatus: NotReady
Events:
  12m   Warning   KubeletStopped   kubelet stopped posting node status
-----end-----
mike: grabbing kubelet logs: journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 on infer-usw-7 -> seeing repeated "kubelet: runtime service not responding: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = containerd: container runtime not ready"
jon: infra-bot says kernel OOM messages on that host in dmesg, lots of process kill (exit code 137) around the same time
anya: cli note: container-runtime flaps + OOMs + kubelet stops -> likely memory pressure on node or runaway pod. prioritizing quick mitigation: cordon + drain affected nodes and shift inference traffic out
sara: please add customer comms if we expect >15 min. I'll draft short note.
mike: cordoning infer-usw-7 and infer-usw-9 now: kubectl cordon infer-usw-7 && kubectl drain infer-usw-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
anya: scaling up fallback capacity in eu-west and us-east by +30% to absorb traffic: autoscaler set to minReplicas + 30% for inference pool non-gpu class
jon: temporary routing tweak: add route rule to prefer eu-west for new requests via traffic-router -> confirm in console
infra-bot: action executed: aws-autoscale increased desired capacity for infer-pool-east and infer-pool-eu by 3 instances each
mike: attempted systemctl restart containerd on infer-usw-7, containerd fails to come up, logs show repeated CUDA driver complaints: "NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus" and stack traces
anya: that suggests hardware or driver instability causing GPU processes to hammer memory + kernel OOM. escalate to hw team for node replacement.
luis: I'll open a maintenance ticket to repro and replace those machines. assigning to infra-hw.
sara: customer note: posting status update: "We are experiencing degraded inference performance in US-West. Traffic is being routed to alternate regions. Engineers are mitigating. No data loss suspected." (will post once you confirm routing and drains) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
anya: confirm: drains completed on 7 and 9, traffic routed away. infer-usw-3 still NotReady, trying soft-restart of kubelet: sudo systemctl restart kubelet -> kubelet comes back but shows node ready then NotReady again after 1m
mike: logs show repeated cgroup/oom events tied to a specific pod: inference-worker-chi-202 - container restart loops, consumes all memory then oom_kill. scaling that deployment down to 0 to stabilize node: kubectl scale deploy inference-worker-chi-202 --replicas=0
jon: good call. after scaling down, node stabilizes. marking infer-usw-3 ready in k8s.
anya: summary so far: root cause likely a runaway GPU-backed worker pod causing OOM on host and GPU driver errors triggering kubelet stop. mitigation: scaled offending deployment down, cordoned/drained bad nodes, routed traffic to other regions, scaled out fallback capacity.
luis: creating follow-up task: postmortem + automated detector for repeated oom_kill + gpu driver falloff. assigning to eng-ml+infra oncall.
sara: status page updated and customers notified of mitigation and that degraded regions are stable with traffic rerouted.
mike: suggested short-term hotfix: add pod-level memory limits and liveness probe to inference-worker image to prevent host OOMs. I can open PR for limits if agreed.
anya: please do. also add node-level alert to detect GPU bus resets and trigger automatic node quarantine.
infra-bot: scheduled actions: mark infer-usw-7 & 9 for replacement, clear cordon after node swap, and run postincident automated checks in 24h
luis: will own the postmortem, target doc by EOD tomorrow. tagging eng-sre and eng-runtime for follow-up.
anya: handing off long-running follow-up to luis. oncall clear for now, still monitoring metrics for 30m. :white_check_mark:
sara: thanks team. please paste the PR link and postmortem when ready. closing the page but keeping channel open for any regressions.
